synthesis.body: A message that branches on sys.platform needs the platform pinned in the test, or the assertion silently encodes whichever platform the author ran on. A macOS-only remediation string asserted without pinning passed locally and failed three CI checks on Linux runners. Pin the branch under test with monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", ...) and add the inverse case, which also catches the opposite defect: platform-specific advice leaking onto a platform that cannot act on it.

title: Pin sys.platform when asserting on platform-conditional output
